title: GoRouter Release Manifest
description: Schema for the release manifest emitted by tools/build next to each release payload. Two builds from identical source and toolchain inputs must produce byte-identical manifests, so no timestamp field is permitted.

commit.description: Full 40-character lowercase hex git commit SHA the payload was built from.

version.description: Semantic version of the release, e.g. v1.2.3 or v1.2.3-beta.1+build.

go_version.description: Go toolchain version used to compile the payload, e.g. go1.25.0.

frontend_hash.description: Deterministic sha256 over the frontend build directory embedded into the payload.

payload_sha256.description: sha256 of the release payload binary.

signature.description: Detached signature over the payload. Null until signing key material is provisioned; signing execution is intentionally excluded from reproducible-build scope.
